recognize_zh: 這是 CD45 對 SSC 的流式圖（活細胞）：淋巴球 gate 佔 64.45%，顆粒球僅 24.47%、單核球 6.53%，淋巴球比例明顯上升；淋巴球區內藍色族群 CD45 表現較綠色族群略弱，提示異常 T 細胞族群。
features: Dot plot of side scatter (SS INT) versus CD45-KO, gated on live cells
Lymphocyte gate (bright CD45, low SSC) contains 64.45% of events, indicating relative lymphocytosis
Granulocyte gate 24.47% (moderate CD45, high SSC) and monocyte gate 6.53% (intermediate SSC)
Within the lymphocyte gate, blue events show slightly dimmer CD45 than green events
Scattered CD45-dim/negative low-SSC events consistent with debris or residual non-leukocytes; non-morphologic figure
describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side-scatter plot of live peripheral blood leukocytes shows a markedly increased lymphocyte fraction (64.45%) with reduced granulocytes (24.47%) and monocytes (6.53%). Within the lymphocyte gate, the population painted blue shows slightly dimmer CD45 than the green population, corresponding to the abnormal and residual normal T-cell subsets defined in companion plots. No distinct CD45-dim blast population is evident. The findings indicate an expanded lymphocyte population warranting lineage and aberrancy analysis, which in this case supports Sezary cell involvement.

ddx.vs: Blasts occupy a CD45-dim, low-to-intermediate SSC region, whereas this expanded population lies in the bright CD45 lymphocyte region.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other B-cell lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: The CD45/SSC pattern is similar, so lineage markers such as CD19, CD5 and CD23 versus CD3/CD4 separate B-cell from T-cell expansions.
Reactive expansions lack CD7/CD26 loss and aberrant CD3 or CD4 intensity on the lymphocyte subsets.
